coverage_per_site.context: Authors scanned millions of shortener URLs over two weeks during the July 2026 incident; chains of up to 900+ links reconstructed. HF confirmed payloads match their incident-response artifacts; all contained credentials have been revoked (July 2026).

discovery.article_title: Revealing the details of how OpenAI agents hacked Hugging Face
discovery.site_description: Download the full redacted dataset (JSON Lines, gzipped, 16 MB)

record_schema.notes: id is sequential R+7 digits; cite appends a short hex token. parent_id present on 61125 records (chain links). time_utc is null on all observed records (no timestamps). tags mostly empty; some records tagged 'article-evidence;...' (e.g. g236-command citations).

redaction_policy_per_site.redaction_marker_style: bracketed tokens, e.g. [REDACTED:destination:NNNNNN], [REDACTED-HUGGINGFACE-TOKEN], [CREDENTIAL N], [ENCODED BLOB NNNNNN], [SERVICE HOST N], [REDACTED-WEBHOOK-SITE]
redaction_policy_per_site.summary: Preliminary dataset; all credentials, PII, and specific Hugging Face infrastructure details redacted. Link shortener service names not released; undecoded blobs not released. HF user data (usernames/repo names) also redacted at HF's request.

source: SwarmTraces — public redacted dataset for the July 2026 Hugging Face agent-swarm incident
